responses.question: Which time zone and day boundary should define whole-account start-of-day equity?
For existing holdings already above the 10% per-security cap, should the system retain/report them, block additional buys in that security, and require human review without automatic liquidation?
responses.answer: Retain/report, block new buys, human review

existing_breach_rule: Retain/report existing holdings; block additional buys in the breached security; require human review; no automatic liquidation
